sample_unit: cardiovascular disease fellows rating discharge instructions

links.outcome: Reading grade level of AI-generated heart failure discharge instructions versus WebMD and Lexicomp
links.effect: ChatGPT-4o instructions required college-level literacy, significantly higher than WebMD and Lexicomp (8th-9th grade), by FRES, FKGL and GFI.
links.quote: Readability analysis found ChatGPT-4o-generated instructions required college-level literacy, significantly higher than WebMD and Lexicomp® (8th-9th grade).

links.outcome: Comprehensibility of AI-generated patient education text relative to routinely used materials
links.effect: AI text relied on abstract cognitive tasks and required college-level literacy, versus 8th-9th grade for WebMD and Lexicomp; quality ratings did not differ statistically.
links.quote: While all sources provided high-quality information, AI-generated materials required significantly higher literacy levels.

unlisted_practices: Prompt engineering to prioritize concrete, behavioral instructions in AI-generated patient education (proposed, not tested)

screen.reason: The study evaluated ChatGPT-4o-generated heart failure discharge instructions by comparing them to standard online materials using clinician expert review (blinded survey of fellows) and readability metrics, but it did not test a deployment practice or safeguard comparison.
